segments: I tried something new last weekend.
I went to a pottery class, and my bowl came out wonky.
Have you done anything different lately?
I did a shift at the charity shop.
I was meant to start at ten.
There were about six bags of clothes and two boxes of books when I got there.
Priya showed me the labels for the rails.
Trousers on one, tops on another.
I put a jumper on the wrong rail and she moved it.
I thought I'd messed it up straight away.
A man brought in a bag with a broken mug in it.
It had a crack all the way down the side.
What did you do with that?
I asked Priya, because I wasn't sure if we could take it.
She said no and put it in the rubbish.
You checked with Priya rather than guessing.
Did anything else happen during the shift?
I did the books after lunch.
There was a whole set of old railway books.
I wanted to look through them, but I was supposed to be sorting them by category.
That sounds frustrating, having to leave the books alone when you wanted to look at them.
I did look at the titles while I was stacking them.
Priya said I could go at three because the back room was tidy.
So you started at ten, sorted clothes and books, checked with Priya about the broken mug, and she let you leave at three when the back room was tidy.
Is there anything else you want me to know about it?
You've given me a good sequence of what happened.
Can we finish five minutes early?
